summary: I have love teaching with @microsofteams. My only real issue is the wiki. Probably the worst of all wikis in the wiki world. No export, no wiki mark up, no HTML, linking pages hard, not really sure what qualifies it as a wiki.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I have love teaching with @microsofteams. My only real issue is the wiki. Probably the worst of all wikis in the wiki world. No export, no wiki mark up, no HTML, linking pages hard, not really sure what qualifies it as a wiki.
